Bash(PGPASSWORD='npg_3QKylioran9V' psql "postgresql://neondb_owner:npg_3QKylioran9V@ep-lingering-firefly-afak5e6q.c-2.us-west-2.aws.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require" -c "
SELECT 
  user_id,
  u.name,
  COUNT\(*\) as total_subscriptions,
  COUNT\(CASE WHEN endpoint LIKE '%apple%' THEN 1 END\) as apple,
  COUNT\(CASE WHEN endpoint LIKE '%fcm%' THEN 1 END\) as android,
  COUNT\(CASE WHEN endpoint LIKE '%wns%' THEN 1 END\) as windows,
  MIN\(created_at\)::date as primeira,
  MAX\(updated_at\)::date as ultima_atualizacao
FROM push_subscriptions ps
JOIN users u ON ps.user_id = u.id
GROUP BY user_id, u.name
ORDER BY total_subscriptions DESC
LIMIT 20;
" 2>&1)

SELECT

  COUNT\(*\) as total_subs,
  COUNT\(CASE WHEN ps.endpoint LIKE '%apple%' THEN 1 END\) as apple,
  COUNT\(CASE WHEN ps.endpoint LIKE '%fcm%' THEN 1 END\) as android,

  MAX\(ps.updated_at\)::date as ultima_atualizacao

" 2>&1)

Bash(PGPASSWORD='npg_3QKylioran9V' psql "postgresql://neondb_owner:npg_3QKylioran9V@ep-lingering-firefly-afak5e6q.c-2.us-west-2.aws.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require" -c "
SELECT 
  COUNT\(*\) as total,
  COUNT\(CASE WHEN ps.updated_at > NOW\(\) - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 END\) as atualizado_7d,
  COUNT\(CASE WHEN ps.updated_at > NOW\(\) - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 END\) as atualizado_30d,
  COUNT\(CASE WHEN ps.updated_at < NOW\(\) - INTERVAL '60 days' THEN 1 END\) as stale_60d,
  COUNT\(CASE WHEN ps.endpoint LIKE '%apple%' THEN 1 END\) as apple_total,
  COUNT\(CASE WHEN ps.endpoint LIKE '%fcm%' THEN 1 END\) as fcm_total,
  COUNT\(CASE WHEN ps.endpoint LIKE '%wns%' THEN 1 END\) as windows_total
FROM push_subscriptions ps;
" 2>&1)

Bash(PGPASSWORD='npg_3QKylioran9V' psql "postgresql://neondb_owner:npg_3QKylioran9V@ep-lingering-firefly-afak5e6q.c-2.us-west-2.aws.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require" -c "
-- Subscriptions que não foram atualizadas há mais de 60 dias \(provavelmente mortas\)
SELECT 
  u.name,
  LEFT\(ps.endpoint, 40\) as endpoint,
  ps.created_at::date,
  ps.updated_at::date,
  CASE WHEN ps.endpoint LIKE '%apple%' THEN 'iOS' 
       WHEN ps.endpoint LIKE '%fcm%' THEN 'Android'
       WHEN ps.endpoint LIKE '%wns%' THEN 'Windows'
  END as plataforma
FROM push_subscriptions ps
JOIN users u ON ps.user_id = u.id
WHERE ps.updated_at < NOW\(\) - INTERVAL '60 days'
ORDER BY ps.updated_at ASC;
" 2>&1)

Bash(PGPASSWORD='npg_3QKylioran9V' psql "postgresql://neondb_owner:npg_3QKylioran9V@ep-lingering-firefly-afak5e6q.c-2.us-west-2.aws.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require" -c "

" 2>&1)
